caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bookcase with a two-part structure: an upper section with glass doors and a lower section with solid wooden doors. The upper part has four tall, rectangular glass panels, each divided by thin wood framing into smaller sections, with arched sections at the top of each panel. Inside the glass doors, there are shelves filled with books of various sizes and colors, including tones of blue, green, red, orange, yellow, and brown. The lower section features four panels, each with a pointed arch design and a wood grain pattern. The entire bookcase is colored in shades of brown, representing wood, with slight variation in hue for different sections to emphasize depth, dimension, and texture. The perspective is slightly angled, showing both the front and a small portion of the right side of the bookcase. The background is a plain, light tan color. The artist's signature, “EILEEN KNOCK,” appears in the lower right corner.
title: Bookcase - Gothic Type
